## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

Describe completed pre-merge checks and their actual results. List genuinely required post-merge-only checks separately as pending or environment-blocked, or state that none are required. Follow the [verification lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification) for evidence and defect follow-up after merge and Issue closure.

## Related issues

Use `Closes #N` for a fully implemented Issue with applicable mandatory pre-merge acceptance satisfied; pending post-merge-only checks do not prevent closure. For intentional partial work, link the parent Issue without closing it and state the remaining scope. See the [development guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#2-create-a-pull-request-for-the-issue).
